label: Ethnic groups present (GeoEPR)
aggregation: number of GeoEPR groups covering >2% of county area
notes: GeoEPR covers only the 10 politically relevant groups (Dinka, Nuer, Azande, Bari, Murle, Toposa, Shilluk, Mundari, Didinga, Anyuak); many smaller groups (e.g. Fertit groups in W. Bahr el Ghazal, Acholi, Madi, Lotuko) are absent, so some counties show 0 groups. Period 2011-2021, treated as static. Polygons may overlap.

label: Dominant group area share
aggregation: largest single-group share of county area
notes: GeoEPR covers only the 10 politically relevant groups (Dinka, Nuer, Azande, Bari, Murle, Toposa, Shilluk, Mundari, Didinga, Anyuak); many smaller groups (e.g. Fertit groups in W. Bahr el Ghazal, Acholi, Madi, Lotuko) are absent, so some counties show 0 groups. Period 2011-2021, treated as static. Polygons may overlap. Dominant group names in data/processed/ethnic_county_lookup.csv.

label: Area of politically excluded groups
aggregation: county area share settled by groups EPR codes as POWERLESS or DISCRIMINATED (2011-2021)
notes: GeoEPR covers only the 10 politically relevant groups (Dinka, Nuer, Azande, Bari, Murle, Toposa, Shilluk, Mundari, Didinga, Anyuak); many smaller groups (e.g. Fertit groups in W. Bahr el Ghazal, Acholi, Madi, Lotuko) are absent, so some counties show 0 groups. Period 2011-2021, treated as static. Polygons may overlap. EPR status: Dinka senior partner, Nuer junior partner, Murle discriminated, others powerless.
